common.quit_body: The game keeps running on the console, but the Remote Play session ends.
conn.detail_channel: Opening the video, audio and controller channel.
conn.detail_connected: The picture is about to show up.
conn.detail_failed: The console did not answer. Check that it is on and try again.
conn.detail_route: Finding a route to the console.
conn.detail_session: The console is setting up a Remote Play session.
consoles.empty_body: Turn the console on (or leave it in Sleep mode), turn on “Enable remote features” in its Devices & connections settings, and choose Refresh.
consoles.lead: Choose where to play. The console needs Remote Play turned on.
consoles.title: Your consoles
settings.about_intro: Fluvi is free software under the GPL 3.0 license. It builds on these projects:
settings.audio_intro: The console sound plays on the Windows default output.
settings.bitrate_d: Automatic uses the most the console accepts.
settings.controller_intro: The controller connected to this PC plays on the console.
settings.credit_ffx_d: Upscaling, sharpening and frame generation. MIT.
settings.credit_fonts: Bricolage Grotesque and Atkinson Hyperlegible Next
settings.credit_fonts_d: The typefaces. SIL Open Font License 1.1.
settings.credit_net_d: WebRTC and audio. MPL 2.0 and BSD.
settings.credit_veyra_d: The connection to the console. GPL 3.0.
settings.fullscreen_d: Borderless, without taking Windows out of its normal mode.
settings.hud_d: Compact shows latency and fps. Full also shows bitrate, losses and the graph.
settings.mode_d: Play has the lowest latency. Smooth makes motion look smoother.
settings.newframes_d: In Play mode, for use with Lossless Scaling.
settings.preset_d: Light spares the graphics card. Max uses the best upscaler it can handle.
settings.resolution_d: 1440p scaled down to your screen looks sharper than 1080p.
settings.rumble_d: The controller rumbles when the game asks for it.
settings.sharpness_d: Applied after the picture is fitted to your screen.
settings.smooth_intro: Play shows only the console frames. Smooth generates frames in between to reach 60 fps.
settings.stats_intro: Latency and fps in a corner of the screen while you play.
settings.strength_d: 100% is the strength the game asked for.
settings.switchhz_d: For monitors without VRR. The original rate comes back when you leave.
settings.title: Settings
settings.upscaler_d: Only used when the screen is bigger than the stream. Automatic follows the quality.
settings.video_intro: These apply right away, except the ones marked for the next connection.
settings.volume_d: Only the game sound, without changing the Windows volume.
signin.idle: Choose Sign in to get your code.
signin.qr_caption: Or point your phone camera here
signin.qr_empty: The QR code shows up here with the code.
signin.step_code: Enter the code below. This screen moves on by itself when you finish.
signin.step_open: On your phone or computer, open
signin.title: Sign in with your Microsoft account
signin.waiting: Waiting for you to confirm the sign-in
stream.latency_cap: {client} ms on this PC and {network} ms of network, round trip
stream.mode_play_d: Only the console frames, with the lowest latency.
stream.mode_smooth_d: Generates frames in between: 30 become 60 fps, with a little more latency.
